openingHours: Real hours from the owner calendar: Mon-Thu 10:00-24:00, Fri-Sat 10:00-04:00, Sun 11:00-24:00 (Europe/Oslo).
assumptions: Sales are simulated; drivers (weather, holidays, events, transit, cruise) are real where the files exist.
Baseline weekday lunch peak 95 transactions/hour; Saturday summer lunch about 145.
No sales lags: the model forecasts from calendar, weather, events, transit and cruise only.
P10/P90 are calibrated by split conformal (CQR) on the last 3 months of train.

Crowds via Nationaltheatret: events at Ullevaal (share 0.35, 10 min), Holmenkollen (0.50, 20 min), Unity Arena Fornebu (0.25, 25 min), Bislett (0.15, 10 min) and Ekeberg (0.10, 20 min) count at any distance. Share = part of the crowd assumed to pass Nationaltheatret; windows are 2 h before (start - travel) and 1.5 h after (end + travel). Simulated response: 0.4 % of the routed crowd per pre hour, 0.8 % per post hour. All assumptions, set from the route map, not measured.

Cruise: a PATTERN, not real calls. July uses the CruiseMapper count for July 2027 (about 151 calls; 8 ships on 3 and 4 Jul, 7 on 22 and 26 Jul); the May, Jun, Aug and Sep counts are an assumed season shape. Simulated response: 1.2 orders per 1000 passengers in port per hour.

featureDefinitions.is_holiday: 1 if the local date is a Norwegian public holiday (date-holidays 'NO', type public).
featureDefinitions.school_holiday: 1 in Oslo school holidays: ISO week 8, ISO week 40, Palm Sunday..Easter Monday, 21 Jun..17 Aug, 21 Dec..2 Jan.
featureDefinitions.payday_window: 1 on payday and the 2 days after. Payday = the 20th, moved back to the previous weekday that is not a public holiday.
featureDefinitions.days_to_christmas: Days from the local date to 24 Dec of the same year, clipped to -7..60 (25 Dec = -1, 31 Dec = -7).
featureDefinitions.ev_active: Sum over event sessions active this hour (within 3 km, not transit/cruise) of attendance * exp(-d/0.8 km) / max(3, session h) / 100. Events over 12 h count as daily sessions; items over 14 days are left out.
featureDefinitions.ev_pre: Sum over events (<= 12 h long, within 3 km) starting in (t, t+3h] of attendance * exp(-d/0.8 km) / 1000.
featureDefinitions.ev_post: Sum over events (<= 12 h long, within 3 km) that ended in (t-2h, t] of attendance * exp(-d/0.8 km) / 1000.
featureDefinitions.ev_near_count: Number of events active this hour within 1 km.
featureDefinitions.transit_disruption: 1 if a transit-category event (within 10 km) or a transit situation (severity not slight/noImpact) is active this hour.
featureDefinitions.rail_late5_share: Share of rail calls in the hour more than 5 min late (Entur). NaN when unknown.
featureDefinitions.rail_cancelled_share: Share of rail calls in the hour cancelled (Entur). NaN when unknown.
featureDefinitions.metro_late5_share: Share of metro calls in the hour more than 5 min late (Entur). NaN when unknown.
featureDefinitions.cruise_pax: Sum of passengers (default 2500) of cruise ships in port this hour / 1000.
featureDefinitions.crowd_nt_pre: Sum over events at a route venue (Ullevaal, Holmenkollen, Unity Arena, Bislett, Ekeberg; no distance cutoff) of attendance x route share / 1000, when the hour overlaps [start - travel - 2 h, start - travel). Shares and travel times are assumptions (ROUTE_VENUES).
featureDefinitions.crowd_nt_post: Same sum when the hour overlaps [end + travel, end + travel + 1.5 h). Events over 12 h count as daily sessions.
featureDefinitions.xmas_market: 1 when Jul i Vinterland (Spikersuppa, ~0.3 km) is open: 7 Nov..3 Jan, closed 24 Dec. 2026 season listed as 7 Nov 2026 - 3 Jan 2027; same window assumed every year.

storeShape.note: Simulated POS shape, checked against the columns real datasets carry (CDRC family-restaurant 15-min slots, Kaggle Recruit daily visits). Ratios are assumptions.
